commercialRealEstateAgents.value: Access to new lease signings before they are public — the highest-value lead timing
commercialRealEstateAgents.approach: Brief presentation of TCD services, sample project portfolio, referral arrangement. Position TCD as adding value to the agent's client relationship — making their job easier.
commercialRealEstateAgents.keyMessage: We make you look good to your tenants by solving their fitout challenge — you refer, we deliver, your client is happy.

interiorDesignersWorkplaceConsultants.value: Designers are specified into projects early — they often select furniture before the client goes to market
interiorDesignersWorkplaceConsultants.approach: Trade account setup with spec pricing, sample kit dispatch, responsive product spec support
interiorDesignersWorkplaceConsultants.keyMessage: We support the design vision with commercial quality, Australian warranty, and installation certainty — we make your project deliver.
interiorDesignersWorkplaceConsultants.arrangement: Trade discount 15–20% or per-project fee arrangement
interiorDesignersWorkplaceConsultants.priority: Very High — one loyal designer can generate $300,000–$800,000/year in referral revenue

ITCompanies.value: IT companies are always involved in office moves (infrastructure relocation, data cabling) and are trusted by operations teams
ITCompanies.approach: Simple referral arrangement — 'we do the furniture, you do the IT'
ITCompanies.arrangement: 1–2% referral on confirmed projects or reciprocal referrals

projectManagementFirms.value: PM firms manage fit-outs end-to-end and select furniture subcontractors
projectManagementFirms.approach: Trade pricing, certified capability demonstration, project management coordination experience
projectManagementFirms.arrangement: Subcontractor terms with PM firm. Maintain margin by building PM firm's margin into pricing structure.

accountingAndFinancialAdvisers.value: Access to business clients evaluating EOFY investments and depreciable asset purchases
accountingAndFinancialAdvisers.approach: EOFY marketing campaign targeted at accountants — 'help your clients maximise their tax position with a planned workspace investment'
accountingAndFinancialAdvisers.arrangement: No formal fee — goodwill and occasional cross-referral

partnerActivationPlan.month1_3: Identify 5 target real estate agents and 5 target interior designers in Brisbane. Make personal introductions. Provide sample kit and project portfolio.
partnerActivationPlan.month3_6: Formalise referral arrangements with 2–3 active referrers. Brief them on TCD's lead qualification and response process.
partnerActivationPlan.ongoing: Monthly check-in with each active partner. Share project completions. Send EOFY and Q4 reminders with marketing material.
partnerActivationPlan.metrics: Track: referrals received per partner / referral-to-project conversion rate / revenue per partner relationship
